test_case.test_name: DC-SCM rear USB2 slots1-2 40C/+5% rails 12-hour margin stress
test_case.purpose: Validate both mapped DC-SCM rear USB2 connectors and their controller path for 12 hours at measured 40C and +5% 5V/3.3V rails without data, reconnect, controller, kernel, SST or BMC errors.
required_package: DC-SCM revision and rear slot1/2 physical-to-OS map
Separate tool/cable IDs and pinned SST profile/concurrency
Calibrated chamber/rail equipment, test points and tolerances
Qualified access, aborts and nominal restoration
test_case.test_command: Operator records DC-SCM revision, photographs rear slots/tools and maps them to OS buses; preserve nominal logs; verify calibration and ramp to approved 40C/+5% rails; confirm both USB2 enumerations; execute the complete attributable 12-hour SST profile with synchronized environment, per-port and DC-SCM controller evidence; restore nominal conditions and revalidate the module and both ports. Agent only post-processes artifacts.
test_case.expected_result: Both exact rear ports remain correctly enumerated and complete required stress while environment stays in tolerance; no disallowed per-port/controller/kernel/SST/SEL event appears; DC-SCM and system remain healthy after restoration.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires DC-SCM revision/topology proof, both connector identities, complete per-port 12-hour coverage, continuous environment and recovery. Front-port evidence, one rear port, aggregate logs, cleared SEL, nominal conditions or shortened stress cannot pass.
safety_gate: Qualified rear-service access and verified connector labels
Approved temperature/rail limits with independent measurement
Abort on controller reset, disconnect, data error or environmental limit
Preserve evidence, restore nominal state, no auto-retry
expected_evidence: Per-port enumeration and complete SST outputs
test_case.recovery: On port, controller or environment failure, stop stress, preserve both-port/module evidence, return rails and chamber to nominal under lab control, verify DC-SCM/system health, and do not automatically rerun.
